zh.title: 夜间观测卡片提示
zh.summary: 无月黑夜和银河时段使用简洁的文字提示。

items.text: 无月黑夜和银河时段对齐标题、时间和状态提示。当天没有可用时段或预报缺测时，用文字说明原因。

en.title: Night observing card messages
en.summary: Moonless and Milky Way cards use simple text for missing data.

items.text: Moonless and Milky Way cards align their titles, times, and status messages. Text explains when there is no observing window or forecast data is missing.
